cues: Between ninety-seven and ninety-nine percent of all the water a plant absorbs is lost as vapour.
Eighty to ninety percent leaves through the stomata, a little through the cuticle, and a tiny fraction through lenticels.
text: Between ninety-seven and ninety-nine percent of all the water a plant absorbs is lost as vapour. That is transpiration. Eighty to ninety percent leaves through the stomata, a little through the cuticle, and a tiny fraction through lenticels.
